name: MnM Cube Cup Malolos 2026

MnM Cube Cup Malolos 2026 returns as the exciting sequel to the successful MnM Cube Cup 2024, once again hosted by [MnM Cube Shop](https://www.facebook.com/MnMCubeShop/) in partnership with [Robinsons Malolos](https://www.facebook.com/RobMalolosOfficial/) and the [Cabalen Cubers Club](https://www.facebook.com/CabalenCubersClub).

Building on the energy and success of its prequel competition, this WCA-sanctioned competition gathers speedcubers from across the country to test their skills in an atmosphere of friendly rivalry and community spirit. With a focus on precision, passion, and growth, MnM Cube Cup 2026 continues to strengthen the cubing scene and celebrate the dedication of cubers of all levels.
